comment: tactical-violent bot band for --sim 5000 --policy tactical. RE-BASELINED in batch 13 (the mercy-economy ride-alongs). Violence remains the LOSING reliable strategy, now more doomed than ever: batch 13's goblin awe/punish made combat riskier (a planted or cornered fighter eats goblin punish hits), dropping competent violence from batch 12's 43.7% to 33.5% (pre-tune) / 33.9% (post-tune, goblin awe_threshold 2). The flip's whole point: the diplomat (51.0%) wins well ABOVE the fighter (33.9%). Measured @ awe_threshold=2: wins 1695/5000 (33.9%), deaths_combat ~2757, deaths_dark 548, stuck 0, kills heavy. Note: violence being doomed at ~34% is on-theme (the arc's 'violence is intuitive but doomed') — the goblin mechanic was NOT weakened to lift this number; the flip and the goblin awe design take precedence. Band brackets the measured value with regression headroom. Final batch-13 [TUNE] values documented in tests/tactical-pacifist-band.json's comment. Calibrated for 5000 seeds. BATCH 15 T1 RE-MEASURE (the goblin talk-gated-awe playtest fix): the violent bot never talks or gives ground, so it's structurally UNTOUCHED by this batch's mercy-mechanics change — measured 1617/5000 (32.3%), deaths_combat 2765, deaths_dark 618, stuck 0: unmoved within measurement noise from batch 13's 33.9%/548. Band UNCHANGED (still comfortably brackets the measured value). BATCH 17 T5 RE-BASELINE (the mimic batch — the cast NPC-vault worldgen MAJOR; instrument parity: the tactical-violent bot needs NO new moves this batch — sword→Hold walk-over pickup already lands the ATK bonus immediately via `Game::recompute_atk`, exactly like the old permanent-Consume model, since this bot never GIVEs/sets-down anything (see `headless::sim_seed`'s doc comment); at a mimic it fights, canon-legal, via the pre-existing bump-attack-when-blocking path, no special-casing needed). Measured 2006/5000 (40.1%), deaths_combat 2631, deaths_dark 363, stuck 0, kills_total 84996 — win_pct ROSE noticeably from batch 15's 32.3% (the guaranteed cast rooms reshape everyone's geometry; not specific to this bot's own behavior, and not from any bot-code change — greedy/pacifist shifted only slightly on the same worldgen, see their own band files) and deaths_dark FELL below the standing [400,800] floor, so that half of the band is widened this batch: win_pct [27,42] stays UNCHANGED (40 still comfortably inside), deaths_dark widens to [200,550] to bracket the new 363 with headroom on both sides.
